main_text.p: כפל Hebr. Duplicare, conduplicare. Ithpeh. אִתְכַּפַּל Duplicari, Ezech. 21.14.
כְּפִיל Ch. Duplum: אֲנָא מְהַדַּר לֵיהּ כְּפִיל Ego reddo ei duplum, Cantic. 8. 7.
כִּפְלָא כּוֹפְלָא Chald. Duplum, duplicatio, Jobi 41. 4. & 11. 6.
כַּפְלְתָּא Ch. Nomen proprium loci, Genef. 23.18. Alius est nomen substantivum, Duplicitas.
כִּפְלָא, כַּפְלָא Chal. Tortuosum, Locus tortuosus, Jesa. 40. 4. & 42.16.
כַּפְלָא Ch. Ilia, Job. 15.27. Plur. כַּפְלֵי Levit. 3. 4. & 10. in Jonath.
כפן Ch. & Syr. Esuriit. Aphel אַכְפִּין Esurire fecit vel sivit, Deut. 8.3. Prov. 10.3.
כְּפִין, כַּפֵּין Chald. & Syr. Esuriens, Famelicus. Plur. כְּפִינִין, כַּפִּינִין: Fœm. כְּפִינָא; & כַּפִּינָא.
כַּפְנָא, כֻּפְנָא Ch. & Syr. Fames. Plur. כַּפְנִין Ruth. 1.1. Syrè כפנין, Matt. 24. 7.

כפס וְכַשְׁרִין סְגִלְגְּלִין וּרְכַסְפָּא כְּפִיסָן עַלְוֵי עַמּוּדֵי מַרְמָרִין Et trabes rotundæ positæ super columnas marmoreas, Esth. 1. 6. Sic Hebræi interpretantur. Regia habent רְפִיסָן Strata.

כפף כַּף, Ch. & Syr. Curvare, incurvare, flectere, inflectere, inclinare: Inflectere, incurvare se, curvari. Præt. plur. fœ. כִּפְפָא Et inclinarunt, Lucæ 24.5. Part. כְּפִיפָן Et flecto ego, ad Ephes. 3. 14. Pah. כַּפֵּף Idem.
כְּפִיף Chald. & Syr. Curvus, incurvatus, ad Rom. 11.10.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several vocalised forms and the Syriac letters are uncertain and may contain errors. The faint text of the facing page is show-through and is omitted.
